title: パワーエレクトロニクス
subtitle: Power Electronics
keywords: Power conversion 2.Power devices 3.AC/DC circuits 4.DC/DC and DC/AC 5.Regional collaboration
educationalGoal: (1) Meaning of Power Electronics and its applications (2) Basic principle, merits and demerits of power conversion using power devices (3) Types and characteristics of major power semiconductor devices (4) Fundamental circuits and operation of AC/DC, DC/DC and DC/AC circuits
advice: Course Description 1.Introduction of power electronics 1.1 Meaning of power electronics 1.2 Principle of high efficiency power conversion 1.3 Types of power conversion 2.Features of power semiconductor devices 2.1 Classification and fundamental structure 2.2 Diode and thyristor 2.3 Power transistor, MOSFET, IGBT 3.Power conversion circuits 3.1 Rectifier circuit (AC/DC circuit) 3.2 Chopper and DC/DC converter 3.3 Inverter circuit (DC/AC circuit) 4.Applications of power electronics Expectations for Students To understand the lecture well, knowledge about electrical circuit, physical electronics, electromagnetics and transient phenomena in liner circuits are required.
requiredKnowledge: This course is strongly related with the following courses: ‘Electric Circuits’, ‘Electromagnetics’, ‘Transient Phenomena in Linear Circuits’, ‘Physical Electronics’, ‘Electrical Machinery’, ‘Generation of Electrical Energy’ and ‘High-voltage Pulsed Power Engineering’. It’s necessary to review the basic knowledges obtained from those related courses in advance.

activityGoals.body: To understand the meaning of power electronics and the features of power conversion using power devices
To understand the types and characteristics of major power semiconductor devices
To understand the fundamental circuit and operation of rectifier, chopper and inverter
To understand the output voltages and currents of rectifier, chopper and inverter
To understand PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) method used for power conversion circuits
To understand the necessity and applications of power electronics

lessons.content: [Guidance] *Explanation of syllabus [Introduction of power electronics] *Meaning of power electronics
lessons.assignments: *To understand meaning and features of power electronics

lessons.content: [Power semiconductor device 1] *Overview of power devices *Basic structure and operation principle of diode and power transistor
lessons.assignments: *To understand symbols and outline of major power semiconductor devices

lessons.content: [Power semiconductor device 2] *Basic structure and operation principle of MOSFET and IGBT *Application fields of power devices
lessons.assignments: *To understand basic structure and operation principle of power MOSFET, thyristor and IGBT

lessons.content: [Quiz 1] *Evaluation targets are the program objectives 1 and 2 *Self-check of understanding level
lessons.assignments: *To review the contents of the lecture 1 to 3

lessons.content: [Rectifier circuit 1] *Principle and basic circuit of half-wave and full-wave rectifier
lessons.assignments: *To understand basic circuit, operation principle and output waveforms of rectifiers using thyrisor

lessons.content: [Rectifier circuit 2] *Condenser-input full-wave rectifier *Externally commutated inverter *Active and reactive power, power factor
lessons.assignments: *To understand operation principle of condenser-input rectifier and externally commutated inverter

lessons.content: [Exercise of rectifier circuit] *Exercise by solving the problems related with rectifier circuit using thyristor
lessons.assignments: *To review the contents of the lecture 5 and 6

lessons.content: [Chopper circuit] *Basic circuit and operation principle of step-down and boost choppers *Operation principle of full bridge chopper
lessons.assignments: *To understand basic circuit and operation of step-down and boost choppers

lessons.content: [DC/DC converter circuit] *Basic circuit and operation principle of forward and fly-back converters *Necessity of isolation for DC/DC converter
lessons.assignments: *To understand basic circuit and operation of forward and fly-back converters

lessons.content: [Exercise of chopper and DC/DC] *Exercise by solving the problems related with chopper and DC/DC converter
lessons.assignments: *To review the contents of the lecture 8 and 9

lessons.content: [Quiz 2] *Evaluation targets are the program objectives 3 to 5 *Self-check of understanding level
lessons.assignments: *To review the contents of the lecture 5 to 10

lessons.content: [Inverter circuit 1] *Classification of inverters *Basic circuit of inverters *Operation principles and waveforms
lessons.assignments: *To understand basic circuit and operation of voltage-source inverter

lessons.content: [Inverter circuit 1] *Classification of inverters *Basic circuit of inverters *Operation principles and waveforms
lessons.assignments: *To understand basic circuit and operation of voltage-source inverter

lessons.content: [Final examination] *Evaluation of the achievement level of program objectives *Look back of learning contents
lessons.assignments: *To review the contents of the lecture 1 to 13

lessons.content: [Self-check lecture] *Explanation of results evaluation method *Notice of evaluation results *Questionnaire of the lecture
